title: Director-Digital Product Ops
text:
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared 
values 
and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

 

Amex Digital Labs is responsible for catalyzing digital innovation by originating, incubating, and managing emerging products and platforms that can be essential to our customers' digital lives. We emphasize creativity, customer centricity, and innovation. Focus areas include crafting industry leading digital payment solutions, leveraging our membership assets to build digital experiences, and defining new products and services based on emerging technologies and trends. The Go-To-Market Director of Risk Innovation will lead the governance and risk management strategy that enables innovation to scale responsibly, overseeing audit and control programs, driving process improvements across Labs and leading issue management.

 

* Outstanding program management skills, with demonstrated ability to lead complex, end-to-end initiatives across multiple priorities and functional areas simultaneously.

* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross functional collaboration, with strong interpersonal and communication skills to influence and engage senior partners across a wide variety of functions.

* Ability to drive results against timelines, prioritize competing demands, and execute with excellence.

* Strong strategic, critical, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to anticipate emerging risks, navigate ambiguity, and develop practical solutions.

* Experience in governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, or operational controls, with the ability to balance risk mitigation and business innovation.

* Experienced and inspiring people leader passionate about developing talent, with a proven track record of leading teams across varying skills and tenure.

* Prior experience leading audit related inquiries, regulatory examinations, or enterprise-wide governance initiatives a plus.

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or PMO certification 
 a plus 
 .

 

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
